assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE transparent PNG game sprite for the Cutting Sand bucket family.
Input image: the local yellow bucket is the exact geometry, perspective, silhouette and layout reference.

Constraints: actually transparent exterior alpha 0, clean antialiased edges; no ground plane, no pink background, no background glow, no cast shadow, no grid, no additional buckets, no text, no digits, no labels, no watermark. Do not draw the screenshot's background or any other UI.
